name: feel-first
direction: Your studio is known for how things feel. Make every input answer within one frame, and give every action motion, sound, and a visible result. Cut a feature before you ship it feeling stiff.

name: strange-idea
direction: Your studio is known for ideas nobody else had. Take the least obvious reading of the brief that still fits it, and commit to that one twist everywhere: names, rules, look, and text.

name: one-thing
direction: Your studio is known for doing one thing perfectly. Find the single core action of the brief, build only that, and refine it until it is the best version of it anyone has seen.

name: first-minute
direction: Your studio is known for unforgettable openings. Design the first ten seconds and the first minute before anything else: what the person sees, does, and wants next.

name: deep-systems
direction: Your studio is known for depth from simple parts. Use a few rules that combine in surprising ways, so a person discovers new strategies the longer they play or use it.
